templatesHuntee.intro: To make test creation fast and convenient, we have prepared 4 unique templates that will help adapt knowledge testing to any needs. Each template has its own concept and style, so you can choose the one that best suits your goals.

baseTest.desc: Simple and clear format: questions with one or multiple correct answers, as well as yes/no questions. Suitable for quick testing of theoretical knowledge and general level of preparation.
baseTest.examples: Usage examples: basic technical check, knowledge of tools, understanding of terms.

mixedMode.desc: A combination of different types of tasks: tests, open questions, short logic or data analysis tasks. Allows comprehensive assessment of the candidate by several criteria.
mixedMode.examples: Usage examples: universal selection for any technical or creative position.

practicalTask.desc: Test with examples of real work tasks: small cases, code snippets, design layouts, or data for analysis. The format is as close as possible to real work.
practicalTask.examples: Usage examples: simulation of work situations for developers, designers, testers, analysts.

scenarioTest.desc: Test in the format of real work situations: the candidate receives a case description and must choose the best solution or propose their own. The format helps to check not only knowledge but also the ability to apply it in context, find optimal approaches, and think critically.
scenarioTest.examples: Usage examples: selection of developers, designers, testers, analysts, and managers when it is important to assess practical thinking and decision-making.

testCreation.intro: The platform provides two approaches to creating tests depending on your goals and needs. The first is individual creation, which allows you to independently choose questions from the database or add your own, configure the test structure, difficulty level, and presentation format. The second is using ready-made tests, developed by specialists taking into account current requirements for various directions and competencies. Both options ensure flexibility and accuracy in the assessment process.

step1.title: Create a test yourself
step1.desc: This option is suitable for companies that want to adapt the testing content to their own requirements as much as possible. You independently form the test by choosing questions from the available database or creating your own. It is possible to configure the test structure, distribution by topics, answer format (open, closed, situational), difficulty level, time limit, number of attempts, etc. This approach allows taking into account the specifics of a particular position, corporate values, or the specifics of the professional direction.

step2.title: Choose a ready-made test
step2.desc: This is the optimal option for a quick start of testing without the need for independent filling. The platform offers a collection of professionally prepared tests covering various IT areas: Front-End, Back-End, UI/UX Design, Data Science, QA, Game Development, Project Management, DevOps, and others. Each test is structured according to modern approaches in HR, psychology, and education, taking into account the analytics of results. You simply choose the necessary test and then send it to candidates or students.

generalInfoPage.title: WELCOME TO HUNTEE!
generalInfoPage.subtitle: Why do we exist?
generalInfoPage.browserText:
Huntee is a modern web platform for online candidate testing with built-in integrity control tools. 
We created it to combine the needs of IT companies for fast and high-quality initial selection of specialists with the opportunity for students and young professionals to show their skills in practice. 
Huntee allows companies to automate the selection process, and candidates - a real chance to get an invitation to an interview and a job. 
Transparent. Objective. No extra steps.

steps.first: Company creates tests and invites candidates.
steps.second: Candidate takes the test online with integrity control.
steps.third: Company receives results and selects those who will receive an invitation to the next stage — interview or job offer.

pro.description: Optimal choice for those who want more.
features: Flexible passing of any test at a convenient time.
Access to special report comparing your results with the group.
Support from Soft Skills Simulation – interview and decision-making simulators.

startITPage.title: WELCOME TO HUNTEE!
startITPage.subtitle: We will help you with a job!
startITPage.browserText:
Your career start begins here!
 We created this platform to help you — a student looking for the first step into professional life.
Here you will find opportunities for your first job and development of practical skills. We are not just a platform — we are your reliable partner on the way to a successful career. With us, your potential will find its way. 
Act now — the future begins today.
